profile_entry.verification: N3 Candidate and verify_profile; every member pinned in immutable files

qualification_identity: SHA256 of compact sorted artifact JSON excluding qualification, first_qualification_authorization and files, then reinserting files except the active evidence file. Legacy qualified manifests retain their original digest. The active evidence bytes must themselves be pinned in immutable files.

first_qualification_authorization.manifest_form: qualification must be explicitly null; first_qualification_authorization names the exact path below. A non-null qualification and this field are mutually exclusive, with no fallback after invalid evidence.
first_qualification_authorization.lifetime: Exact nonempty current boot and future integer monotonic deadline, revalidated on admission, selection, publication and direct health gating.
first_qualification_authorization.supervision: Expiry rejects validation but does not terminate an existing daemon or playback. The separately approved private protocol must arm and verify bounded stop supervision before first use.

build_receipt: N2 compilation receipt, never preparation receipt; output hashes/sizes, runtime model hash, board, profile and kernel must agree. source_receipt points to the pinned N2 preparation receipt and must match compilation.source_receipt_sha256, commit and lock_sha256.
abi_files: Absolute runtime paths with existing owner {sha256,size} or {symlink} entries. Each must agree with N2 compilation.external_inputs.sysroot (relative paths there); symlink targets must themselves be in the ABI closure.
selection: Under the common lock, read the fresh helper report, verify N3 staged closure and exact-ID qualification, check preflight, publish selected.json atomically, then latch attempt before any loads. Registration completion binds the canonical selection SHA256. No reload/retry after attempt.
packaging: Stage these runtime_python_sources as sibling basenames under the namespaced daemon directory, pin every byte in the immutable manifest, retain both source licenses and the exact donor model. Do not install the user drop-in in this phase.
session_gate: Absent native card returns success without touching external/session audio. Present native card requires completed qualification and the root-attested gate. First-test authorization never admits an ordinary session, even after root readiness; only the separately isolated private test may use the direct health gate.
